title: Stage 4: Loans and concurrency
summary: Lend and return copies safely, and protect edits from lost updates with a concurrency token.

steps.title: Two librarians, one copy
body: The library has one copy of Dune. Two librarians, at two desks, lend it at the same moment. Both read "1 available", both save "0 available" and a loan. Now two people have the one copy.
The same race hits edits: two people fix a book's title, and the second silently overwrites the first.
Both are solved with one **concurrency token** on `Book`:

- **Lending** loads the book, checks `Available`, decrements it and **bumps `Version`**. If another desk changed the book in between, the `UPDATE ... WHERE "Version" = @old` matches nothing and EF Core throws `DbUpdateConcurrencyException`: answer `409`, nobody gets a phantom copy.

- **Editing** (`PUT /books/{id}`) receives the version the client last saw. Setting it as the token's **original value** makes the save fail if the book has changed since, even if the change happened long before this request.

steps.prompt: Lending does `book.Available--; book.Version++;` then saves. Why bump `Version` too, when `Available` already changed?
options: The token is what the UPDATE checks; changing it makes every other writer who read the old version fail instead of overwriting
EF Core requires every save to change the version
To count how many loans there have been
Because `Available` cannot be a concurrency token
steps.explain: Only token properties go into the `WHERE`. Bumping it on every write means any writer holding an older version loses the race and gets a conflict.

steps.title: Lending, returning, editing
prompt: Keep everything from stage 3 and add:

**Model:** `Book` gains `int Copies` (default 1), `int Available` (default 1) and `[ConcurrencyCheck] int Version`. `POST /books` accepts an optional `copies` (`record NewBook(..., int AuthorId, int? Copies)`; default 1, at least 1) and sets `Available` to it. `GET /books/{id}` now returns `{ id, title, isbn, year, author, copies, available, version }`.

- `PUT /books/{id}` with `record EditBook(string? Title, int Year, int Version)`: `400` for a blank title, `404` if missing; set the token's **original value** to the client's version, update title and year, set `Version` to the client's version + 1, save. `200` with `{ id, title, year, version }`, or `409` on a concurrency conflict.

- `POST /loans` with `record NewLoan(int BookId, int MemberId, DateOnly Due)`: `404` for an unknown book or member; `409` when `Available` is 0; otherwise decrement `Available`, bump `Version`, add the loan, save (`409` on a concurrency conflict). `201` with `{ id, bookId, memberId, due }`.
- `POST /loans/{id}/return`: `404` if missing, `409` if already returned; otherwise mark it returned, give the copy back (`Available + 1`), bump the book's `Version`, save, `204`.

- `GET /members/{id}/loans`: `404` for an unknown member; otherwise `[{ loanId, title, author, due, returned }]` ordered by due date, then loan id. (Any correct version will do for now; stage 5 makes it fast.)

static class DojoTests
public static async Task Run(HttpClient http)
await Dojo.TryAsync("loans and concurrency", async () =>
await Post(http, "/authors", new { name = "Frank Herbert" });
await Post(http, "/books", new { title = "Dune", isbn = "9780441013593", year = 1965, authorId = 1 });
var dojoTwo = await DojoWeb.Json(await Post(http, "/books", new { title = "Children of Dune", isbn = "9780547773742", year = 1976, authorId = 1, copies = 2 }));
await Post(http, "/members", new { name = "Ana", email = "ana@example.com" });
await Post(http, "/members", new { name = "Ben", email = "ben@example.com" });
var dojoBook = await DojoWeb.Json(await http.GetAsync("/books/2"));
Dojo.Eq("a new book reports copies, available and version", "2 2 0", $"{DojoWeb.Prop(dojoBook, "copies")} {DojoWeb.Prop(dojoBook, "available")} {DojoWeb.Prop(dojoBook, "version")}");
var dojoEdit = await http.PutAsJsonAsync("/books/1", new { title = "Dune (50th anniversary)", year = 2015, version = 0 });
DojoWeb.Status("PUT /books/1 at version 0 responds 200", 200, dojoEdit);
Dojo.Eq("...and returns version 1", "1", DojoWeb.Prop(await DojoWeb.Json(dojoEdit), "version"));
DojoWeb.Status("a second PUT still at version 0: 409", 409, await http.PutAsJsonAsync("/books/1", new { title = "Stale", year = 1, version = 0 }));
DojoWeb.Status("PUT /books/9: 404", 404, await http.PutAsJsonAsync("/books/9", new { title = "X", year = 1, version = 0 }));
Dojo.Eq("the stale edit was not saved", "Dune (50th anniversary)", DojoWeb.Prop(await DojoWeb.Json(await http.GetAsync("/books/1")), "title"));
var dojoLoan = await Post(http, "/loans", new { bookId = 1, memberId = 1, due = "2026-12-01" });
DojoWeb.Status("POST /loans responds 201", 201, dojoLoan);
Dojo.Eq("...with the due date", "2026-12-01", DojoWeb.Prop(await DojoWeb.Json(dojoLoan), "due"));
DojoWeb.Status("the only copy is out: 409", 409, await Post(http, "/loans", new { bookId = 1, memberId = 2, due = "2026-12-01" }));
DojoWeb.Status("an unknown book: 404", 404, await Post(http, "/loans", new { bookId = 9, memberId = 1, due = "2026-12-01" }));
DojoWeb.Status("an unknown member: 404", 404, await Post(http, "/loans", new { bookId = 2, memberId = 9, due = "2026-12-01" }));
var dojoAfterLoan = await DojoWeb.Json(await http.GetAsync("/books/1"));
Dojo.Eq("lending took the copy and bumped the version", "0 2", $"{DojoWeb.Prop(dojoAfterLoan, "available")} {DojoWeb.Prop(dojoAfterLoan, "version")}");
DojoWeb.Status("an edit at version 1 is now stale: 409", 409, await http.PutAsJsonAsync("/books/1", new { title = "X", year = 1, version = 1 }));
DojoWeb.Status("POST /loans/1/return responds 204", 204, await http.PostAsync("/loans/1/return", null));
DojoWeb.Status("returning it twice: 409", 409, await http.PostAsync("/loans/1/return", null));
DojoWeb.Status("returning loan 9: 404", 404, await http.PostAsync("/loans/9/return", null));
Dojo.Eq("the copy is back", "1", DojoWeb.Prop(await DojoWeb.Json(await http.GetAsync("/books/1")), "available"));
DojoWeb.Status("so Ben can borrow it", 201, await Post(http, "/loans", new { bookId = 1, memberId = 2, due = "2026-12-03" }));
await Post(http, "/loans", new { bookId = 2, memberId = 1, due = "2026-11-20" });
var dojoMine = await DojoWeb.Json(await http.GetAsync("/members/1/loans"));
Dojo.Eq("GET /members/1/loans, by due date", "Children of Dune|Dune (50th anniversary)", Each(dojoMine, "title"));
Dojo.Eq("...with author and returned flags", "Frank Herbert false|Frank Herbert true",
dojoMine.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Array ? string.Join("|", dojoMine.EnumerateArray().Select(l => DojoWeb.Prop(l, "author") + " " + DojoWeb.Prop(l, "returned"))) : "(not an array)");
DojoWeb.Status("GET /members/9/loans: 404", 404, await http.GetAsync("/members/9/loans"));
static async Task<HttpResponseMessage> Post(HttpClient http, string url, object body) => await http.PostAsJsonAsync(url, body);
static async Task<string?> Id(HttpResponseMessage r) => DojoWeb.Prop(await DojoWeb.Json(r), "id");
static string Each(JsonElement json, string prop) =>
json.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Array ? string.Join("|", json.EnumerateArray().Select(x => DojoWeb.Prop(x, prop))) : "(not an array)";
static JsonElement Field(JsonElement json, string name)
if (json.ValueKind != JsonValueKind.Object) return default;
foreach (var p in json.EnumerateObject()) if (string.Equals(p.Name, name, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) return p.Value;
return default;
